adminUrl.title: Conversation page address in your admin
adminUrl.description: The page of your admin where staff open a conversation, for example https://admin.example.com/inbox?conversation={conversationId}. Alerts link to it.

frequency.title: New message alerts
frequency.description: First unanswered: once until staff reply or open the chat. Every message: on every visitor message.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: Also alert Accounts staff whose role may reply in the inbox (inbox.reply), or all_staff for everyone who may see it. Needs the Accounts connection. Empty: only the alert people set in the Portal (Website settings › Team and alerts).

includePhone.title: Alerts carry the visitor's phone
includePhone.description: Adds the value {phone} (the phone the visitor signed in with or left) to the new message and Chat needs you alerts.
